name: Daybreak Ammunition
text:
Ammunition any

Activate 1 (manipulate)

---
The bronze inlays of daybreak ammunition glow noticeably, even under direct sunlight. When activated daybreak ammunition hits a target, the missile flares with an aura of bright light in a 10-foot emanation from the target for 1 round. Each creature in the area must attempt a DC 18 Fortitude save save. Creatures with darkvision take a –2 circumstance penalty to this save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is Dazzled for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Blinded for 1 round.

Effect: Daybreak Ammunition
